# GCPCloudSQL

The GCP Cloud SQL data connector provides the capability to ingest logs into Microsoft Sentinel using the GCP Cloud SQL API. With the broader resource.type=cloudsql_database collection it now covers Cloud SQL admin/management audit logs, data-access audit logs (pgAudit DDL/DML events) and engine/session logs (connect, disconnect and failed-login lines from postgres.log and similar). Refer to [GCP cloud SQL Audit Logs](https://cloud.google.com/sql/docs/mysql/audit-logging) documentation for more information.
